title: Review system design for testability
description:
Analyze current architecture and identify testability challenges and opportunities for improvement.

Current state:
- Operations has some pure algorithms hiding behind I/O dependencies
- Models are fully testable (Issues can be constructed directly)
- Storage and JJ are I/O layers (should be effectful by design)
- Shell orchestration tested via trycmd

Areas investigated:
- Can we separate pure business logic from I/O effects? YES
- Should we introduce traits for Storage and JJ? NO (imperative shell, functional core)
- Can logic be tested as methods? YES, if struct initialization does not require I/O
- Are resolve_id, next, and summary testable? NOT CURRENTLY (need extraction)
- Can Issue be constructed without effects? YES (Issue::new is pure)

Deliverable: TESTABILITY_ANALYSIS.md documents analysis of testability, recommendations for extracting pure logic (not traits), and explains the testing approach.
